title: Coin Change
statement_short: Given an integer array coins representing coins of different denominations and an integer amount representing a total amount of money, return the fewest number of coins that you need to make up that amount. Return -1 if that amount cannot be made up.
hint: Target amount up to 10^4 requires computing minimum coins for each sub-amount up to amount using dynamic programming.
why_not: Right: 1D DP computes minimum coins needed for each amount i from 1 to target (dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i-coin] + 1)) in O(amount \* n) time. Not Greedy: Greedy picking largest coins fails for non-canonical coin systems (e.g. coins [1, 3, 4] for amount 6). Not Graph BFS: Shortest path BFS on an amount state graph works, but 1D DP array updates are the standard unbounded knapsack pattern. Not Backtracking: Exploring all coin combinations recursively causes TLE.
